title: Seitiassist
description: All-in-one terrain editing assistant with wand, area pickaxe, auto-trash, and lava freezer
body:
# Seitiassist - Terrain Editing Assistant

An all-in-one plugin that makes terrain editing and mining work comfortable. Includes 4 powerful tools for efficient block management.

## Features

### 1. Magic Wand (範囲消去の杖)
- **Area Selection** - Left-click for Point A, Right-click for Point B
- **Bulk Deletion** - Delete all blocks in selected area with /sa clean
- **Diamond Cost** - Consumes diamonds based on block count (64 blocks = 1 diamond)
- **Bedrock Protection** - Bedrock is never deleted

### 2. Area Mining Pickaxe (範囲採掘ツルハシ)
- **Variable Range** - Switch between 1x1, 3x3, 5x5, 7x7 with right-click
- **Smart Direction** - Mines in the direction you're facing
- **Sneak Mode** - Hold sneak for single-block mining
- **Durability System** - Respects Unbreaking enchantment

### 3. Smart Trash (スマートゴミ箱)
- **Auto-Delete** - Automatically destroys picked-up items you don't want
- **XP Conversion** - Converts trashed items into experience points
- **GUI Settings** - Easy inventory-based configuration
- **Per-Player Data** - Each player has their own filter list

### 4. Fluid Freezer (流体凍結アシスト)
- **Lava to Obsidian** - Converts lava into obsidian
- **Water to Cobblestone** - Converts water into cobblestone
- **Offhand Trigger** - Hold packed ice in offhand while mining
- **XP Cost** - Consumes experience per block converted

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/sa wand [player]` | Give magic wand | `seitiassist.command.wand` |
| `/sa clean` | Delete selected area | `seitiassist.command.clean` |
| `/sa pickaxe [player]` | Give area pickaxe | `seitiassist.command.pickaxe` |
| `/sa trash` | Open trash settings | `seitiassist.command.trash` |
| `/sa fluid [player]` | Give fluid freezer | `seitiassist.command.fluid` |
| `/sa reload` | Reload config | `seitiassist.admin` |

**Alias:** /seiti

## Permissions

| Permission | Default |
|------------|---------|
| `seitiassist.command.wand` | op |
| `seitiassist.command.clean` | op |
| `seitiassist.command.pickaxe` | op |
| `seitiassist.command.trash` | true |
| `seitiassist.admin` | op |

## Requirements
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+

---

## 日本語 (Japanese)

整地作業を快適にする4つのツールを搭載した統合アシストプラグインです。

**1. 範囲消去の杖:** 左右クリックで範囲選択、/sa cleanで一括削除。ダイヤモンド消費。

**2. 範囲採掘ツルハシ:** 右クリックで1x1〜7x7切り替え。向いている方向に範囲採掘。

**3. スマートゴミ箱:** /sa trashでGUI設定。登録アイテムを拾うと自動破棄してXPに変換。

**4. 流体凍結アシスト:** オフハンドに青氷を持って採掘すると周囲の溶岩/水を固化。
